_note: Mints Germany's own national-accounts quality report as a node distinct from the underlying release it describes (de-destatis-national-accounts, already imported in de-destatis-national-accounts.json since 2026-08-05). The two are different documents: one is the GDP/national-accounts release itself, the other is Destatis's own meta-report on the quality of that release. Per esa2010-quality-reporting.json's pre-existing finding, nothing in EU regulation compels a member state to publish a national-accounts quality report -- these are voluntary documents, which is part of why they are worth minting as their own node rather than folding into the release.

reports.title: Quality Report -- National Accounts
reports.description: Destatis's own quality report on the German national accounts (EVAS No 81), covering 'domestic product calculation (production, use, and distribution approaches), input-output accounts, national wealth accounts, employment accounts, volume of labour accounts and financial accounts'. States its own legal basis as 'Regulation (EC) No 549/2013, European System of National and Regional Accounts (ESA) 2010, and supplementary and amending regulations'. Voluntary: nothing in EU regulation compels a member state to publish a report of this kind (esa2010-quality-reporting.json _second_finding); Destatis produces one on its own initiative.
reports.cadence_note: Document's own cover page: reference period '10/2024-09/2025', 'Periodicity: annual', 'Published: 24/10/2025'. Read directly this session via pdftotext extraction of the live PDF (destatis.de/EN/Methods/Quality/QualityReports/National-Accounts-Domestic-Product/national-accounts.pdf).

release_schedule.note: This is a methodological 'Quality Report' (part of Destatis's SIMS-style quality reporting framework offered 'since 2005' for all federal statistics), not a periodic statistical release. The current PDF is dated 29 October 2025 (per its own title page), but neither the report's landing/introduction page (https://www.destatis.de/EN/Methods/Quality/QualityReports/National-Accounts-Domestic-Product/einfuehrung.html) nor the general quality-reports overview page (https://www.destatis.de/EN/Methods/Quality/quality-reports.html) states any fixed update frequency, review cycle, or publishes a release calendar for it. No prior editions with dates could be located to establish an observed annual (or other) pattern within the available tools (web search budget was exhausted and archive.org access was blocked by the proxy). Given the absence of any calendar, stated rule, or confirmable pattern, this is classified as irregular; the corpus's releases_per_year=1 could not be confirmed or refuted with direct evidence.
